card.name: The word daily after doses
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "daily" right after a dose amount such as "mg" or "tablet". Also fires on a few other nouns that follow a modifier, like "wireless", "nitrogen" and "chemotherapy".

modes.label: Daily after dose
modes.description: The word "daily" follows a strength or tablet in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Other nouns after a modifier
modes.description: A single noun that follows a modifier in non-dosing text, such as wireless, nitrogen or chemotherapy.
